page.layout: Two columns of lexicon entries, left and right, with Hebrew and Latin text; no margin notes. Right column has a centred letter heading (ע ט) partway down. Page number 347 at top right. Catchword "Rad." at bottom right; gathering signature "Xx 2" at bottom left.

main_text.p: No. f. m. Rad. עָזַז robo-ravit.
עָזְנֵךָ[?] nundinae tuae, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. עָזַב reliquit.
עָזָה vehemens, עֲזוּזָה vehementes, No. f. & pl. fæm. à f. m. עָז; Rad. עָזַז roboravit.
עָז robur ejus, עָזִי meum, עָזְךָ tuum, עָזָם, עָזָּם eorum, &c. No. sing. m. עָז, vel עָזוֹ, aff. Rad. עָזַז.
בְּעָזוֹ cum roboraret, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. עָזַז.
עָזּוּז robustus, & עָזּוּז robur, No. f. m. R. עָז.
עָזִי robur meum, עָזְךָ tuum, &c. No. f. m. עָז, vel עָזוֹ, aff. Rad. עָזַז roboravit.
עָזִים capræ; עָזֶךָ tuae, pl. aff. à f. f. No. Rad. עָז capra.
עֲזִיָּה halieætus, No. sing. fæm. Rad. עָזַז roboravit.
עֲזְרָתָה omnimodum auxilium, f. cum duplici terminatione f. g. constr. עֶזְרַת, à No. עֶזְרָה auxilium, R. עָזַר auxiliatus est.
main_text.head: ע ט
main_text.p: עִיט volucris, No. f. m. constr. à No. עַיִט avis.
עָמְדוּ amiciverunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. עָמָה amiciendo, Inf. Kal, R. עָמַה.
כְּעָטָה quasi operta, Cant. 1.7. Ben. Kal, f. f. à f. m. עָטָה, Rad. עָטָה.
עַטְנָיו multralia ejus, No. pl. m. aff. à f. m. עַטָּן, Rad. inusit. עָטַן.
עַטְשְׁתָיו sternutationes ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. à f. f. עַטְשָׁה, Rad. inusit. עטש.
עָטְךָ amiciens te, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. עָטָה, aff. Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew forms in this transcription are read from a degraded scan and may contain errors; uncertain Hebrew and Latin readings are not all individually marked. The running head on the left is doubtful. The Latin word "halieætus" and "multralia" are as far as I can read them. The letter heading ע ט is treated as a level 2 head. The final "Rad." is taken as a catchword.
